instruction: Navigate to the page showcasing United Airlines flight deals and special offers.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from United Airlines homepage to the special offers/deals page. Similar complexity to original baggage calculator task - single navigation within united.com. Uses regex pattern to match deals, offers, or promotions URLs. Uses existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_info extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree, which is appropriate for verifying navigation
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match uses regex pattern matching to verify URL, which is suitable for checking navigation to deals/offers pages
Complete coverage: The single requirement (navigate to special offers/deals page) is fully verified by checking the URL pattern
Expected value is semantically correct: The regex pattern 'united.com/en/us/(deals|offers|promotions)' correctly matches the requirement for navigating to United Airlines special offers/deals page
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts URL -> Metric compares URL against regex pattern -> Returns 1.0 if pattern matches
No state timing issues: Active tab URL is always accessible for verification
Parameter handling is correct: When expected.type='rule', framework calls get_rule which returns config['rules'], so metric receives {'expected': [...]} and can access rules['expected'] properly
